Kforce's client in Lansing, MI is seeking a Data Scientist with a strong foundation in statistics, probability, applied mathematics, and quantitative problem-solving. 

Summary:
This role is best suited for someone who can take ambiguous scientific or business problems, determine the appropriate mathematical or statistical approach, work through imperfect real-world data, and develop and validate defensible quantitative solutions. The ideal candidate does not need prior expertise in a specific business domain. More important is the mathematical, statistical, and computational depth to independently learn unfamiliar problem spaces and apply the appropriate methodologies.

This role is centered on Data Science and Mathematics rather than pure ML/AI Engineering. We are looking for someone who understands the reasoning and mathematics behind the models they build, rather than simply applying standard machine-learning libraries. The strongest candidates will demonstrate depth in quantitative modeling, statistical reasoning, experimental design, and mathematical problem-solving, along with the ability to communicate their approach clearly.

  Strong proficiency with Python and SQL 
  Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and applied mathematics 
  Experience developing and validating statistical and machine-learning models 
  Experience working with messy, sparse, imbalanced, or otherwise imperfect real-world datasets 
  Strong understanding of experimental design, model validation, uncertainty, and appropriate performance metrics 
  Ability to translate ambiguous scientific or business problems into testable quantitative approaches 
  Experience working with multiple types of data, such as tabular, time-series, spatial, sensor, spectral, or image data 
  Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar technical problems and determine the appropriate mathematical or statistical methodology 
  Strong programming and general computer science fundamentals 
  Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 
Experience in one or more of the following areas is beneficial but not required:
 
  Geospatial analysis 
  Environmental or weather data 
  Time-series modeling 
  Computer vision 
  Hyperspectral or spectral data 
  Risk modeling 
  Optimization 
  Scientific computing 
  Production engineering

  A challenging quantitative problem they personally worked through

  How they assessed whether the available data were sufficient and appropriate 
  How they validated their conclusions, models, or results

  What they would have done differently with better data or additional time

Software Engineer
Minitab is looking for a Software Engineer to help develop and maintain its software products and systems. At Minitab, you'll do more than build software, you'll help transform the future of manufacturing. Every day, the world's leading manufacturers rely on Minitab to increase efficiency, improve quality, reduce waste, and make smarter, data-driven decisions that power better factories and better products. Our smart manufacturing platform connects data across the enterprise to uncover hidden capacity, eliminate bottlenecks, optimize machine performance, simulate improvements before implementation, and accelerate innovation through advanced analytics and experimental design. As part of our team, you'll collaborate with passionate, talented colleagues who are solving meaningful, real-world challenges for global industry leaders. With more than 250,000 users, 30,000 organizations, and 90% of the Fortune 100 trusting Minitab, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact while growing your career in a collaborative, innovative, and customer-focused environment where your ideas matter.
What you’ll do
Implement and test software applications and systems as part of a team.
Develop new features and enhancements in line with technical designs.
Troubleshoot and fix software defects within the scope of your work.
Perform routine software maintenance tasks as directed.
Build your skills, product knowledge, and understanding of the codebase and software development life cycle.
Communicate progress on assigned work according to team and company practices.
Participate in code reviews by seeking feedback and responding to input from teammates, reviewers, and subject matter experts.
Collaborate with cross-functional team members to help deliver team commitments on time.
What you’ll bring
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
An understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as C++, C#, Python, or JavaScript.
Experience with web development technologies such as HTML/CSS and JavaScript, and web frameworks such as React, Vue.js, .NET Core, or Node.js.
Demonstrated growth mindset, curiosity, and eagerness to learn and develop new skills.
The ability to speak, read, write, and comprehend English.
This is an onsite position at our State College, PA headquarters and candidates must be within commutable distance of State College, PA for consideration. Remote work is not an option for this position.
